claim: No draw of the main pass puts a dark decal or sprite under units, at any pose of land_40, land_small or siege_small (run 20261106_j25pc). The blended draws are 12 at every pose: particle.fx, grid_spline.fx deployment and battlefield borders, sun.fx, cloud_plane.fx; at low poses a 13th, decal.fx decal_to_frame_t0_sm2 (ps 5c9bd7a4bb31b068, not in the catalogue, one batched draw of 240 triangles), which is the blue formation outline: skipping that one shader removes the outline and nothing else (raw/d_skip). sprite.fx in the main pass is opaque, alpha tested, cube mapped and not blended. So a blob shadow is one of two things. (1) The imposter caster past the unit LOD switch (napoleon.shadow.unit_lod): a cascade redraws the same imposter quad at more texels, so it sharpens the blob and does not remove it, and at a 40 m split the units at the deploy poses are outside the cascade anyway; only the LOD distance removes it (J27). (2) The sun-behind collapse of near mesh shadows (napoleon.shadow.view_angle): the near cascade removes it, its density has no yaw dependence (best/worst 1.0 against 3.37 at 2048)
notes: owner J25; the cost of a longer imposter distance is J27's (J9 saw 90 shadow draws instead of 48 with the switch at 1000 m), not measured here
